_help: This is the ONLY file you need to edit. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored.
Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. A date range is written START/END, e.g. 2026-10-05/2026-10-09 (both ends included).
After you commit a change, GitHub regenerates SCHEDULE.md and checks the file for typos automatically.
Someone can't present?      -> add the date(s) to `unavailable` under their name. The next person moves up; they present next.
Advisor takes the slot?     -> add the date to `special_sessions` with a title and who leads it. The rotation pauses that day.
No meeting at all?          -> add the date to `no_meeting` with a reason.
Force specific presenters?  -> add the date to `overrides` with the exact list of names.
Someone joins or leaves?    -> add them to `rotation` and give the date in `joined` / `left`.
_slack_ids_help: Optional. Paste each person's Slack member ID (profile > three dots > Copy member ID) to @-mention them in reminders. Leave empty to show plain names.
